notes.title: Goddamnit, I mean just...
notes.notes:
I simply wanted to make enough to be able to afford app space here for my next, much bigger and in-depth game that I'm currently working on.

I woke up to such amount of money and support, that I've never ever saw in my time being a Developer - Hell, I've never seen this amount of money ever in my life.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517461/07d5890c3107a97b299bcdf16c12634a67a1b64e.png[/img]

To see fellas getting invested and enjoying my creation - it's not just a great ego boost but it's also such a big motivation boost.
I HAVE TO out do myself each passing day
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517461/5904bb2fb46f547b5981be792ade6a6cd3c566f4.png[/img]
And truly, Thank you.

KvitravnDev.

(By the way, [b]Kvitravn[/b] means "[u]White Raven[/u]", means [i]Huginn[/i], one of Odinn's ravens - Huginn and Munnin.
[i]Huginn[/i] being "[b]Thought[/b]" and [i]Munnin [/i]being "[b]Memory[/b]")

notes.title: Making Memories Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Making Memories v1.0[/h1]
[b]Making Memories[/b] is finally[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2549960/Making_Memories/] released[/url]!

It's quite a lot to take in that my stuff is on steam, seems daunting really but hey, I've done it.

I've made this game out of a inner want to have something out there, something I can proudly call mine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517461/dac6f3a83e62cd3255220844142fa6d016d8c856.png[/img]
For the past 9 years I've been in the movie industry, doing all of sorts of things with moderate success, but the role was never one of the shot caller in projects.

And even though behind the scenes I've been told that I'm a great writer or what not, I was happy just making changes and assisting others vision - until now.

I see this medium a way of telling my stories, my way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517461/717a6a817d4d3a17bc837b9fe21dd43fba089708.png[/img]
I believe in living with my characters, share their happiness and their pains, which made my life in turn a lot less numb.

I don't know what to say about this game - Just enjoy it!
I sure did enjoyed making it.

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://i.postimg.cc/GpgWKTF2/image.png]Insuff. Wishlists...[/url]
Well, as you can see- less than 1k wishlists.

According to steam's algorithm, a game that's exceeded 7K wishlists is seen profitable and will be pushed in the stored.

I'm not going to wait for 7K of course, that's just impossible without delay it much, much further - which I'm not going to do.

I'm only delaying it by 5 days, to 7th october, to at least see it through 1000 - 1100 Wishlists.
I'm hoping above 1K will at least get some crumb of traction.

If anyone sees this, I also urge you to help me out in any capacity you can, every bit helps!

Thank you and sorry.

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
So, September's a busy month- MK1, Starfield, Phantom Liberty, Payday 3, Lies of P, NBA2k24, FC24, and whatnot.

So not only do I wanna avoid these dates, I wanna enjoy these games myself!
So I'm delaying the release to Oct 2, yeah I know we still won't have nearly as much time to get through any of these games but- Delaying further would be a scummy move personally.
